title: Chiefs dominate Broncos behind big night from Kenneth Walker
channel_name: The Athletic Football Show: A show about the NFL
text: The Denver Broncos flipped the script on the Kansas City Chiefs last year, ending the latter's reign atop the AFC West and coming within one win of the Super Bowl. We're not going to draw any sweeping conclusions after one game, but if Week 1 is any indication, the Broncos might not want to get used to life atop the division. Robert Mays, Derrik Klassen and Dave Helman break down the Chiefs' comfortable 31-10 win over the Broncos on this episode of The Athletic Football Show.
